question: Do paper gate decisions computed from Helius shadow state agree with the unchanged PumpPortal decision lane closely enough to justify a later Helius-backed evidence path?
oracle: PumpPortal remains the sole runtime decision input during this experiment.

walletRule.reason: On-chain ground truth showed Helius event user is canonical while sampled PumpPortal traderPublicKey values matched neither event user nor fee payer.
walletRule.required: Every comparable evaluation must carry explicit Portal-vs-Helius wallet feature and tracked-address accounting; executed action divergence remains a hard failure regardless of cause.

prohibitions: No Helius shadow state may feed runtime strategy decisions.
No live enablement or gate loosening may follow from this experiment alone.
Thresholds and identity semantics are frozen before the first eligible run.
A failure cannot be repaired by changing the comparator key inside the same evidence era.
nextIfPass: Build a Helius-backed full-coverage evidence path and validate it alongside paid PumpPortal tape for one eligible session before retiring the paid-tape requirement.
nextIfFail: Autopsy divergence by market features, wallet identity, state age, and executed action before changing any procurement route.
